headline: Man City fall again as Delap's double inspires Forest
description: Liam Delap's brace earns Nottingham Forest an empathetic 3-1 victory, condemning Manchester City to their third straight EPL loss.

headline: Enzo Maresca calls for 'balance' after Man City suffer third straight Premier League defeat
description: Enzo Maresca has said he is "concerned" about Manchester City's form after they suffered a third Premier League defeat with a 3-1 loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday.
